name: Context-Based Adaptive Ray Sampling with Quadtree Subdivision
aliases: Fast Learning Radiance Fields by Shooting Much Fewer Rays method
Fast Learning Radiance Fields by Shooting Much Fewer Rays method, Ours
Probability-based Ray Sampling with Quadtree Subdivision
definition: A training-stage sampling strategy that uses a quadtree to partition the image space, sampling more rays in nontrivial areas (high color change/high rendering error) and fewer in trivial areas to reduce training burden while capturing details.
summary: Context-Based Adaptive Ray Sampling with Quadtree Subdivision is a training-stage strategy that accelerates radiance field learning by using rendering error to hierarchically subdivide a quadtree and applying context-based probability density for intra-block sampling.
